verdict.rationale: Google Voice is a SaaS telephony service, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question. The evidence shows no such spec: probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. The only API reference cited is the Workspace Admin Reports activities endpoint, which is a different product's REST reference, not a downloadable Voice spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
